card.name: Linking words before oncology drug names
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (as, of, and, with, vs, a comma or colon) that come right before a cancer drug name or drug class, such as androgen receptor antagonists, bortezomib, Kyprolis or duvelisib.

modes.label: Class lists
modes.description: The word "as" or a colon introduces examples of androgen pathway drugs.
modes.example: targeting the androgen pathway, such<< as>> androgen receptor antagonists, can result

modes.label: Before a named drug
modes.description: "of", "and", "with", "vs" or a comma sits just ahead of a specific cancer drug.
modes.example: have occurred following administration<< of>> Kyprolis. Some events occurred in

modes.label: Drug lists
modes.description: A comma between oncology drugs in an interaction list.
modes.example: dasatinib, lapatinib, nilotinib bortezomib<<,>> busulphan, docetaxel
